messages:
maria: FYI we're planning the tenant_metadata column add + shadow backfill in the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. aiming for online apply + streaming backfill.
kevin: noted. what's the quiesce window? any writes to that table expected during the slot?
maria: trying to avoid full quiesce — plan is to add column nullable, then stream-copy via a per-tenant job. minimal locks. quiesce only for final index swap (~30s) if all goes well.
anjali: +1 for streaming approach. can we enforce row-limit on the backfill workers so we don't blow up replica lag? suggest 200 rows/sec per worker.
maria: yes will set rate limiter, and a global backoff if replica lag > 30s. I'll add probe to the runbook.
sam: deploybot scheduled at 01:50 UTC to reserve slot. can you paste the pin and rollforward steps so I add to the release note?
maria: pin: `release: v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21`
anjali: runbook snippet:
```
# backfill worker
./bin/backfill --table tenant_metadata --batch 500 --rate 200 --max-retries 3
# monitor
curl -s https://infra-metrics/replica_lag | jq .lag_seconds
```
maria: deploybot: request holdpoint at upstream canary after schema apply (hold for 10m). will run 1 shard canary (~5% traffic) first.
deploybot: holdpoint set at 02:05:00 UTC for thread 1745556666. canary traffic rule created -> 5%.
ci-bot: nightly-integration: all tests passed for v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21 (build 2148) :white_check_mark:
kevin: if we see any long-running vacuum or bloat on replica, abort backfill and rollback to pinned version. what's the rollback plan?
maria: rollback plan: disable backfill workers, revert feature flag, but keep new nullable column (safe). if we need full rollback we run `pg:swap-views` to point to old read path and re-pin previous service binary `v3.7.0`.
anjali: add immediate alert on replica lag > 60s and on any >5% error spike in canary route.
sam: added alerts and release note: "tenant_metadata shadow-add + streaming backfill; canary 5% -> full rollout; rate-limited backfill with replica-lag guard." link to runbook: https://internal/runbooks/shadow-backfill
kevin: one more — DB locks: ensure we `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` is non-blocking. we'll run `pg_repack` if we see long table-level locks.
maria: confirmed using `ADD COLUMN` with default NULL (instant). final index create will be CONCURRENTLY.
anjali: during canary watch we'll be in #eng-oncall.
maria: sounds good. any objections to starting at 02:00 UTC? no objections -> proceeding.
kevin: ack. I'll be on standby.
sam: Deploybot will post status updates during the window.
deploybot: canary started at 02:05 UTC (5% traffic). monitoring hooks active.
ci-bot: smoke: ok. latency within baseline for canary endpoints.
maria: backfill workers ramping to rate=200/s across 4 workers.
anjali: seeing slight replica lag ~8s — within threshold.
kevin: keep an eye. if lag hits 25s I want an immediate throttle to 50/s.
maria: throttle applied -> 50/s.
deploybot: canary passed holdpoint. proceeding to 25% -> 100% rollout in 3 waves.
sam: rolling to 25% now.
maria: final index create scheduled CONCURRENTLY in wave 3; will do final swap at 03:12 UTC.
kevin: if swap fails, we abort and leave column as nullable; ops will follow rollback plan.
maria: swap complete at 03:11:45 UTC. no errors. closing window.
deploybot: rollout complete. release pinned: v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21. cc @eng-sre for postmortem only if issues.
maria: thanks all! saved runbook to the release note. :party_parrot:
